description: This source file implements functions for unpacking quantized weights in ONNX models within the PyTorch JIT compiler, including pattern matching, weight conversion, and graph transformations related to quantized operations.

methods.name: CreateQuantizedWeights
methods.description: Creates nodes for unpacked quantized weights and associated parameters based on weight tensor and qscheme.

methods.name: CreateQuantizedBias
methods.description: Creates a node for quantized bias tensor.

methods.name: createIntTuple
methods.description: Creates a node representing an integer tuple constant.

methods.name: createInt
methods.description: Creates a node representing an integer constant.

methods.name: ConvertQuantizedWeight
methods.description: Converts a packed weight node into unpacked weight nodes and updates the graph.

methods.name: unpackQuantizedWeightsHelper
methods.description: Pattern matches and unpacks quantized weights for specific ONNX quantized operators.

methods.name: UnpackQuantizedTensorInputs
methods.description: Unpacks quantized tensor inputs into {value, scale, zero_point} tuples.

methods.name: UnpackQuantizedWeights
methods.description: Main function to unpack all quantized weights and inputs in the graph, including pattern matching and graph modifications.

methods.name: insertPermutesHelper
methods.description: Inserts permute nodes to convert between NCHW and NHWC formats around quantized conv operations.

methods.name: insertPermutes
methods.description: Inserts permutes for specific quantized conv operators to match Caffe2 format expectations.
